def start(self) -> bool:
        """
        Construct and start Atlas.
        """

        logger.info(
            "Constructing AtlasApplication"
        )

        self.application = AtlasApplication(
            execution_mode="PAPER",
        )

        logger.info(
            "Starting AtlasApplication"
        )

        started = self.application.start()

        if not started:
            self.exit_code = 1

            logger.error(
                "AtlasApplication reported startup failure"
            )

            self._display_latest_error()

            return False

        display_startup_status(
            self.application
        )

        return True

def __init__(
        self,
        *,
        exchange_name: str = "binance_global",
        execution_mode: str = "PAPER",
        symbols: list[str] | None = None,
        market_interval: float = 10.0,
    ) -> None:
        logger.info(
            "Initializing %s v%s",
            self.NAME,
            self.VERSION,
        )

        self.exchange_name = str(exchange_name)
        self.execution_mode = str(execution_mode).upper()
        self.symbols = list(symbols) if symbols else None
        self.market_interval = float(market_interval)

        self.running = False
        self.initialized = False

        self.created_at = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
        self.started_at: str | None = None
        self.stopped_at: str | None = None

        self.errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self.started_services: list[str] = []

        self._build_infrastructure()
        self._build_services()
        self._register_services()

        self.initialized = True

        logger.info(
            "%s initialized successfully",
            self.NAME,
        )

methods.source:
def _build_services(self) -> None:
        """
        Create and connect Atlas business services.
        """

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Portfolio
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        self.capital = CapitalManager()
        self.paper_trader = PaperTrader()

        self.position_controller = PositionController(
            event_bus=self.event_bus,
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Intelligence
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        self.brain = AtlasBrain(
            event_bus=self.event_bus,
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Market data
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        self.market_feed = MarketFeed(
            exchange_name=self.exchange_name,
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Execution
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        self.execution = ExecutionManager(
            capital_manager=self.capital,
            position_controller=self.position_controller,
            paper_trader=self.paper_trader,
            event_bus=self.event_bus,
            mode=self.execution_mode,
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Market loop
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        self.market_loop = MarketLoop(
            brain=self.brain,
            market_feed=self.market_feed,
            execution=self.execution,
            event_bus=self.event_bus,
            symbols=self.symbols,
            interval=self.market_interval,
        )

        # -----------------------------------------------------
        # Controller
        # -----------------------------------------------------

        self.controller = AtlasController(
            brain=self.brain,
            market_loop=self.market_loop,
            execution=self.execution,
        )

methods.name: start
methods.source:
def start(self) -> bool:
        """
        Start Atlas services in dependency-safe order.

        Returns:
            True when Atlas starts successfully.
            False when startup fails.
        """

        if self.running:
            logger.warning(
                "Atlas is already running",
            )
            return True

        self.started_services.clear()
        self.stopped_at = None

        try:
            logger.info(
                "=================================================="
            )
            logger.info(
                "ATLAS STARTUP SEQUENCE"
            )
            logger.info(
                "=================================================="
            )

            self.runtime.boot()
            self.runtime.initialize()

            self.started_at = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Execution subsystem
            # -------------------------------------------------

            self.execution.start()
            self.started_services.append("execution")

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Exchange connection
            # -------------------------------------------------

            self.runtime.connect()

            self.market_feed.start()
            self.started_services.append("market_feed")

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Intelligence
            # -------------------------------------------------

            self._start_optional_service(
                name="brain",
                service=self.brain,
            )

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Runtime ready
            # -------------------------------------------------

            self.runtime.ready()

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Market loop
            # -------------------------------------------------

            self.market_loop.start()
            self.started_services.append("market_loop")

            # -------------------------------------------------
            # Controller
            # -------------------------------------------------

            self.controller.start()
            self.started_services.append("controller")

            self.runtime.start()
            self.running = True

            logger.info(
                "ATLAS SYSTEM ONLINE"
            )
            logger.info(
                "Started services: %s",
                self.started_services,
            )

            return True

        except Exception as exc:
            self._record_error(
                phase="startup",
                error=exc,
            )

            logger.exception(
                "Atlas startup failed"
            )

            try:
                self.runtime.fail(
                    str(exc),
                )
            except Exception:
                logger.exception(
                    "Runtime failure transition failed"
                )

            self._rollback_startup()
            return False

methods.name: _start_optional_service
methods.source:
def _start_optional_service(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        service: Any,
    ) -> None:
        """
        Start a service only when it exposes a callable start method.
        """

        start_method = getattr(
            service,
            "start",
            None,
        )

        if callable(start_method):
            start_method()

        self.started_services.append(name)

methods.name: _rollback_startup
methods.source:
def _rollback_startup(self) -> None:
        """
        Stop any service that may have started before startup failed.
        """

        logger.warning(
            "Rolling back partial Atlas startup"
        )

        self.stop()

def __init__(
        self,
        brain: Any,
        market_feed: Any,
        execution: Any | None = None,
        event_bus: Any | None = None,
        symbols: list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None = None,
        interval: float = 10.0,
    ) -> None:
        self.brain = brain
        self.market_feed = market_feed
        self.execution = execution
        self.event_bus = event_bus

        self.symbols = self._normalize_symbols(
            symbols or self.DEFAULT_SYMBOLS
        )

        self.interval = max(
            1.0,
            float(interval),
        )

        self.processor = CandleProcessor()
        self.technical = TechnicalAnalyzer()
        self.world = WorldAnalysisEngine()
        self.decision_adapter = DecisionAdapter()

        self.running = False
        self.stop_event = threading.Event()
        self.thread: threading.Thread | None = None
        self.lock = threading.RLock()

        self.started_at: str | None = None
        self.stopped_at: str | None = None
        self.last_cycle: str | None = None
        self.last_cycle_duration = 0.0

        self.last_signals: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.last_executions: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

        self.metrics: dict[str, int | float] = {
            "cycles": 0,
            "symbols_scanned": 0,
            "symbols_skipped": 0,
            "decisions_received": 0,
            "decisions_normalized": 0,
            "decisions_rejected": 0,
            "hold_decisions": 0,
            "execution_requests": 0,
            "executions_completed": 0,
            "executions_rejected": 0,
            "execution_failures": 0,
            "errors": 0,
            "latency": 0.0,
        }

        self.errors: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        logger.info(
            "Atlas Market Loop v%s initialized",
            self.VERSION,
        )

def start(self) -> bool:
        """
        Start the market worker thread.

        Returns:
            True when the loop starts or is already running.
        """

        with self.lock:
            if self.running:
                logger.warning(
                    "Market Loop is already running"
                )
                return True

            self.running = True
            self.stop_event.clear()

            self.started_at = datetime.now(
                UTC
            ).isoformat()

            self.stopped_at = None

            self.thread = threading.Thread(
                target=self.worker,
                name="AtlasMarketLoop",
                daemon=True,
            )

            self.thread.start()

        logger.info(
            "Market Loop started"
        )

        return True

def __init__(
        self,
        exchange_name: str = "binance_global",
        *,
        provider: MarketDataProviderProtocol | None = None,
        event_bus: Any | None = None,
        metrics: Any | None = None,
        publish_events: bool = True,
        collect_metrics: bool = True,
        failure_threshold: int = (
            MarketFeedService.DEFAULT_FAILURE_THRESHOLD
        ),
    ) -> None:
        normalized_exchange = (
            str(exchange_name)
            .strip()
            .lower()
        )

        if normalized_exchange not in self.SUPPORTED_EXCHANGES:
            raise ValueError(
                "MarketFeed v2 supports public Binance Global data only. "
                f"Unsupported exchange_name={exchange_name!r}."
            )

        self.exchange_name = normalized_exchange

        self.provider = (
            provider
            if provider is not None
            else BinancePublicDataProvider()
        )

        self.service = MarketFeedService(
            provider=self.provider,
            event_bus=event_bus,
            metrics=metrics,
            publish_events=publish_events,
            collect_metrics=collect_metrics,
            failure_threshold=failure_threshold,
        )

        logger.info(
            "MarketFeed compatibility adapter initialized: "
            "exchange=%s provider=%s",
            self.exchange_name,
            self.service.provider_name,
        )
